PROPERTY GUARDIAN PROGRAM
Nobody Knows the Future, But You Can Prepare for It!
The Property Guardian Program (PGP) is a tool for property and
facility managers who choose to be proactive rather than reactive
when it comes to business disruption or interruption from water,
fire or storm damage or the discovery of mold or other biohazards.
The PGP is designed to offer a variety of levels of service and
commitment, allowing each property or facility manager to “curate”
or customize a program that works best for them and the facilities
they are responsible for.
The PGP establishes a relationship between the property or facility
manager and a restoration contractor who will function as a
Disaster Preparedness Advisor and provide restoration services
according to the specifics of the PGP.
The Property Guardian Program is ideal for property managers,
facility managers, property owners, risk managers and other
responsible parties that not only see the value in being proactive
but also:

We will mitigate the loss including board-up and tarping, structural drying, providing restorative cleaning as well as other appropriate
actions to stabilize the situation and prevent further damage.
To accomplish this we will provide a variety of resources including labor, equipment, materials, tools and other necessary items as
needed.
We will supply personnel trained in accordance with Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) and the Institute of
Inspection Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC) standards.
We will have appropriate commercial general liability, pollution liability and workman’s compensation insurance coverage.
Our company and our employees will keep all information pertaining to your operations and the emergency situation confidential, unless
otherwise required by law or to protect life, health or safety.
We will respond, execute a service agreement and begin stabilization and emergency services immediately without an initial deposit
being required. This will allow us to respond immediately to losses after hours or on weekends without delay.
Under normal conditions, when an emergency occurs, we will respond to initial notification of the emergency within 15 minutes and will
arrive on-site within 2 hours barring extenuating circumstances such as traffic, etc.
During a severe, area-wide weather event, our “next available crew” service pledge means that we will provide priority response to all
PGP (Preferred) clients with the next available crew before any other non-PGP service requests are fulfilled.
We will provide transparency through comprehensive documentation and regular updates so that any third party such as Regional
Managers, distant property owners and Claims Adjusters can see what the source of the loss was and what steps are being taken to
restore it. This allows you to stay updated on the progress of restoration without being inconvenienced and creates a permanent record
of proper restoration.
As your “Claims Administrator” we will help you manage the process and provide the highest levels of communication.
As “Mitigation Specialists” our approach will control costs and return you to normal operations faster.
Our comprehensive documentation and working to the Standard of Care will help assure you that the work was done correctly and
protect you from liability and lawsuits.
At your request, we will offer a thorough debriefing after any emergency to review what happened and why, examine whether additional
preventive measures should be implemented as well as review the restoration in terms of process, equipment utilized, costs,
documentation and other details.
We will provide a certificate of professional restoration that demonstrates that the loss was restored to the IICRC S500 & S520 Standards
of Care. A comprehensive documentation packet is also available upon request.
This protects the property’s value, protects against “sick building” issues (real or imagined), enhances tenant retention and protects
against downstream liability and lawsuits.
